facts.fact: Feature P279: run stopped by restart offers Resume.
Backend tests for P279: flows/adeflow TestResumeAfterRestart and TestResumeLostConversation, under contract ade-resume.
Restart-stopped run appears in Needs you tab as item kind "stuck run" with action text 'Resume'.
Release stage step line shows Resume button for restart-stopped run.
Clicking Resume calls IPC adeTaskResumeRun once with args { runId }, e.g. { runId: 'r_T_cart_release_b_cart' }.
Resumed run that finishes has no Resume button.
Run with lost conversation has no Resume; shows Retry and run note containing 'could not resume'.
When Resume refused (contract AdeTaskService.ResumeRun#refused), error message shows in release stage block's error.
